args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but per FIN-212 monetary rounding must use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py`.

## Changes
- Switch `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` (commit `08d3cd5986`) on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212`: **passed**, including `test_half_even` (2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)
